title: 第16章 人种袋第17章 大补
content_zh:
“额……”
楚夏一整个无语住了。
连眼里对灵药的渴望都瞬间熄火。
甚至於，万神鼎都停止了震动。
仿佛连万神鼎都觉得，这要求实属有些过分。
“我能先听一下原因嘛。”
楚夏说道。
他还是有点意外的。
姜云芝要生孩子，是因为她需要依靠先天帝气恢復实力。
可夏紫萱这又是闹的哪一出？
“繁衍后代，人之常情，需要理由嘛？”
夏紫萱嫣然一笑。
但这样的解释显然不足以打动楚夏。
“好吧，我承认，我有些害怕了。”
“因为皇陵刺杀？”
夏紫萱摇了摇头：“身为长公主，我从小到大经歷的暗杀不计其数，只是暗杀不足以嚇到我，但祖龙祭典开始后，我便有一种强烈的预感……我可能坚持不到最后。”
“原本我並未考虑过繁衍之事，可在皇陵祭拜母后时，我突然想到，假若我死了，那今后还会有人给母后扫墓嘛，如果母后的血脉断在我手里，我又是否有顏面在九泉之下面见母后呢。”
“可如果我有一个孩子，那一切或许会变得截然不同。”
“就算我死了，我的孩子还能继承我的意志，去完成我未能达到的目的，哪怕我的孩子办不到，孩子的孩子依旧能够將我的血脉传递下去，子子孙孙无穷尽也，那么终有一天，我的心愿会实现的。”
嗯……

楚夏明白了。
夏紫萱要的不是孩子，而是一个希望。
她所承受的压力，或许比楚夏看到的要更大。
倒也不是不能理解。
“可时间已经不多了，难道你想顶著个大肚子去参加祖龙祭典？”
“谁说我要亲自生了。”
楚夏又蒙了。
是你自己要孩子，你又不亲自生，那你图什么呢？
难不成这个世界还有代孕的技术？
那楚夏可真是孤陋寡闻了。
“你过来，我告诉你。”夏紫萱勾了勾手指头。
楚夏耐不住好奇，还是凑了过去。
夏紫萱伏在楚夏耳边，低声道：“珍宝阁里有一件法宝，是前朝遗留下来的宝贝，唤做『人种袋』，有孕化万物之效，只要將你的那啥，跟我的那啥混在一起装进人种袋里，便可形成胚胎，而且可以自由控制孵化的时间，我若顺利贏得皇位，那自然用不上，可我如果哪天暴毙而亡了，便可將人种袋送出宫去，十个月后我的孩子就能出生了。”
content_en:
"Um..."
Chu Xia was completely speechless.
Even the desire for the elixir in his eyes was instantly extinguished.
Even the Ten Thousand God Cauldron stopped vibrating.
It seems that even the Ten Thousand God Cauldron feels that this request is a bit excessive.
"Can I hear the reason first?"
Chu Xia said.
He was still a little surprised.
Jiang Yunzhi wants to have a baby because she needs to rely on her innate imperial energy to regain her strength.
But where did Xia Zixuan cause trouble?
"It is human nature to reproduce and reproduce. Do we need a reason?"
Xia Zixuan smiled brightly.
But this explanation was obviously not enough to impress Chu Xia.
"Okay, I admit, I'm a little scared."
"Because of the assassination at the Imperial Tomb?"
Xia Zixuan shook her head: "As the eldest princess, I have experienced countless assassinations since I was a child. The assassinations alone are not enough to scare me, but after the Ancestral Dragon Festival started, I had a strong premonition... I might not survive until the end."
"Originally I had not considered reproduction, but when I was worshiping my mother in the imperial mausoleum, I suddenly thought, if I die, there will be people who will visit my mother's grave in the future. If my mother's bloodline is cut off in my hands, will I have the face to see my mother under the Nine Springs?"
"But if I had a child, maybe everything would be completely different."
"Even if I die, my children can still inherit my will and accomplish the goals that I failed to achieve. Even if my children cannot achieve it, their children can still pass on my bloodline. There will be endless descendants. Then one day, my wish will come true."
Hmm...
Chu Xia understood.
What Xia Zixuan wants is not a child, but a hope.
The pressure she was under might be greater than what Chu Xia saw.
It’s not that I can’t understand it.
"But time is running out. Do you want to go to the Ancestral Dragon Festival with a big belly?"
"Who said I was going to give birth myself."
Chu Xia was confused again.
You want the child yourself, and you don’t give birth to it yourself, so what do you want?
Is it possible that there is still surrogacy technology in this world?
Then Chu Xia is really ignorant.
"Come here, I'll tell you." Xia Zixuan hooked her fingers.
Chu Xia couldn't bear to be curious, so she still came over.
Xia Zixuan leaned next to Chu Xia's ear and whispered: "There is a magic weapon in the Treasure Pavilion. It is a treasure left behind by the previous dynasty. It is called a 'human race bag'. It has the effect of pregnant and transforming all things. Just mix your things with mine and put them into the human race bag." , the embryo can be formed, and the time of incubation can be controlled freely. If I successfully win the throne, it will naturally not be used. But if I die suddenly one day, I can send the human seed bag out of the palace, and my child will be born in ten months."
